# conclusion

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:conclusion`](gmeow-conclusion.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/conclusion>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The single conclusion of a reified [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) — the [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) the argument establishes (vantage = the reasoner, [`observedFeature`](gmeow-observedFeature.md) = the concluded proposition). Functional: one commitment, one conclusion; an argument with two conclusions is two commitments (SHACL enforces exactly one).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) -> [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:conclusion`](gmeow-conclusion.md) from [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) to [`gmeow:StandpointClaim`](../classes/gmeow-StandpointClaim.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Abduction

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inference/examples/abduction.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inference/examples/abduction.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-inference-examples-abduction)#example-slices-core-inference-examples-abduction

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inference/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- The reified argument (endurant relator) -------------------------------- #
ex:abductiveCommitment a gmeow:InferenceCommitment ;
    rdfs:label "Abductive argument: best explanation of the fever"@en ;
    gmeow:inferenceModeOf gmeow:modeAbduction ;
    gmeow:premise ex:symptomObservation ;        # >= 1 premise, != conclusion (SHACL)
    gmeow:explanandum ex:fever ;
    gmeow:candidateHypothesis ex:hypInfluenza , ex:hypCold ;
    gmeow:conclusion ex:hypInfluenza ;           # exactly one conclusion = the winner
    gmeow:warrant "inference to the best explanation: influenza maximises explanatory score"@en .
```

### Analogy

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inference/examples/analogy.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inference/examples/analogy.ttl)

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inference/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



ex:analogicalCommitment a gmeow:InferenceCommitment ;
    rdfs:label "Analogical argument: solar-system structure transferred to the atom"@en ;
    gmeow:inferenceModeOf gmeow:modeAnalogical ;
    gmeow:premise ex:premOrbits ;
    gmeow:conclusion ex:conclElectronsOrbit ;
    gmeow:warrant ex:rutherfordAnalogy .          # the warrant IS the structure-mapping
```
